units: all x,y,bbox,pts in frame fractions of 1376x768; r = fraction of frame HEIGHT; pivot = fraction of the layer box; amp = max sideways displacement as fraction of frame width; speed = cycles/second
draw_order: plate -> beam/disc/shimmer/flicker fx -> figures -> particles(front ones) -> dormouse -> caption

flicker.note: the single oil-lamp flame on the table (painted); flicker only, glow radius small

shimmer.note: heat haze right above the lamp flame
slow wobble of the painted smoke curl rising from the lamp (between John and Jesus); no figure pixels are warped

particles.note: a few slow warm motes in the lamp pool over the table, never over Jesus's face

route.note: starts in the scene on the mat, lower-left corner
one jump onto the open earth floor in front of the table
watches Jesus breaking the bread, eyes open; between the old man's back and the two backs, below every face

caption.note: plain dark plaster and the small dark window at the upper left; the left group's heads start at y~0.36

dormouse.note: y = feet contact; present from t=0, one jump, exit jump from 8.67 by the engine
